items.title: The Buffett Indicator Keeps Flashing Red. Is It Broken?
items.summary: If you’ve spent even a short while scrolling through YouTube looking for investing content, you’ve seen them—video thumbnails with illustrated flames and maybe a downward pointing arrow warning about the end times.  Relax:  Warren Buffett  isn’t predicting a stock-market collapse.  The Oracle of Omaha made that remark a quarter-century ago, when he was a sprightly 71-year-old.
